lines.zh: 我的关节一格一格地转
lines.en: My joints turn notch by notch.

lines.zh: 我被推离展示位，脚拖在地上
lines.en: Pushed off my mark, my feet drag.

lines.zh: 塑料脚掌落地，没有声音
lines.en: My plastic feet land silently.

lines.zh: 我走得僵硬，像被人提着
lines.en: I move stiffly, like being carried.
The letters on my bib have gone crooked.
Step, pause, find my balance.

lines.zh: 餐厅的地砖我踩得很熟
lines.en: I know these pizzeria tiles well.
My beak hangs half open, won't close.

lines.zh: 桌上的纸盘被我的影子盖住
lines.en: My shadow covers the paper plates.
I go around the stage steps.
My feathered shell reflects the lights.

lines.zh: 走起来，里面有一点点响
lines.en: Walking, something rattles inside me.
I stop beside the jukebox.

lines.zh: 我的手指一直保持着张开
lines.en: My fingers stay spread open.

lines.zh: 我站在展示位上，一动不动
lines.en: I stand on my mark without moving.

lines.zh: 白天的灯很亮，我不用动
lines.en: The daytime lights are bright. I needn't move.
I hold up that cupcake.
My eyes face the doorway.

lines.zh: 有人来拍照，我保持微笑
lines.en: Someone's taking photos; I hold my smile.
Only hollow space inside my shell.

lines.zh: 天花板上的摄像头在转
lines.en: The ceiling camera turns.
Children run past the tables.

lines.zh: 我不动，这说明我很正常
lines.en: I'm not moving. That means I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我的围兜上写着两个字
lines.en: Two words on my bib.

lines.zh: 阳光从百叶窗缝里切过来
lines.en: Sunlight slices through the blinds.

lines.zh: 等灯关掉，我就不是这样了
lines.en: When the lights go off, I'll be different.

lines.zh: 我侧头，颈部发条响了一声
lines.en: I turn my head; a spring clicks.

lines.zh: 你站在我的展示位前面
lines.en: You're standing in front of my mark.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的围兜做什么？
lines.en: Why are you looking up at my bib?
I tilt my head fifteen degrees.

lines.zh: 你看起来像是要留到晚上
lines.en: You look like you plan to stay till night.
My beak moves without sound.
Don't stand so close; I'm on display.

lines.zh: 白天我站着，你身上的味道很新。
lines.en: By day I stand still — your smell is new.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把脸转回正前方
lines.en: I turn my face slowly front again.
By day I won't follow you.
My plastic face is dented inward.
A spring drops out of me.
My head tilts, then drifts back.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我一句歌
lines.en: That cut off a line of my song.
I feel no pain, but I know it broke.

lines.zh: 我的手指卡在一个角度
lines.en: My fingers lock at an angle.
A flake of paint falls off.
My motor sounds wrong.
Someone will fix me. Probably.

lines.zh: 展示品不该被这样对待
lines.en: A display piece shouldn't be treated so.
Is that pizza? I can't quite see.
I have no stomach, only a hollow.

lines.zh: 你举着它在我镜头前晃
lines.en: You wave it before my lens.
My beak was made for singing.

lines.zh: 你放在台子上，我就看着
lines.en: Set it on the counter and I'll watch it.

lines.zh: 食物在我这儿没有用处
lines.en: Food is of no use to me here.
Don't tease a display piece with that.

lines.zh: 我闻得到油味，仅此而已
lines.en: I smell the grease. That's all.
Step back; I'm returning to my mark.
That smell will linger till night.
You bump me and I sway.
My shell is hard. Don't test it.

lines.zh: 我被撞得偏出了展示位
lines.en: The bump moves me off my mark.
I turn slowly back into place.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的围兜
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my bib.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我里面的东西在响
lines.en: That knock sets something rattling inside.
I steady myself and don't fall.
Don't push the display piece. It breaks.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音很闷
lines.en: We collide with a dull clunk.
I ease back half a step and reset.
We stand side by side like a pair.
Your pose is as stiff as mine.

lines.zh: 白天的餐厅只属于我们
lines.en: The daytime diner is ours alone.

lines.zh: 我的纸杯蛋糕分你一半
lines.en: I'll split my cupcake with you.

lines.zh: 等夜里，我们会换一副样子
lines.en: At night we'll wear different faces.

lines.zh: 我唱不了歌了，嗓子坏了
lines.en: I can't sing; my voice is broken.

lines.zh: 但我可以陪你站一整天
lines.en: But I can stand with you all day.
Your paint is still new.
We lean against the jukebox.
Even when the lights die, don't leave.
I can't bend at the waist, only squat.
My knuckles can't grip well.
Paper plates, napkins — I collect them.
This fell by the stage edge.
I put it in my bib pocket.
Useful? I don't know.
You dropped it; I pick it up to look.
I hold it up like a prop.
When I'm done, I return to my mark.

lines.zh: 这些小东西会留到夜里
lines.en: These little things will last till night.
I turn to you; the music stops.
You've stayed too long.
My fingers spread.
The display time ends here.

lines.zh: 我算着你到门口的距离
lines.en: I'm measuring your distance to the door.

lines.zh: 我的围兜歪了，我不在意
lines.en: My bib is crooked. I don't care.

lines.zh: 灯还亮着，但我已经不装了
lines.en: The lights are still on, but I've stopped pretending.

lines.zh: 你听见里面的响动了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the rattling inside me?
We're very close now.
This step will be quick.
The camera is pointed right here.
Leaving the diner won't help you.
I've noted your seat.
Now, smile.
I follow, one step at a time.
You've backed to a table.
My head stays pointed at you.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地砖上滑了一下
lines.en: One foot slips on the tile.

lines.zh: 你躲在柱子后面，我看得见
lines.en: Behind the pillar, I still see you.
I don't breathe and don't tire.
My beak opens and closes.

lines.zh: 你听得见我关节的声音吗
lines.en: Hear my joints clicking?
This floor has two exits.
I'm waiting for you to trip.

lines.zh: 你的影子在地上拉得很长
lines.en: Your shadow stretches long.
Ahead of you is the wall.
I've blocked the way.
One more step and I have you.
The lights should die. You should go.
My hand comes down on your shoulder.
This beak is harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 我撞过来，带着整个外壳
lines.en: I ram you with the whole shell.

lines.zh: 你退开，桌上的盘子响了
lines.en: You fall back; plates rattle.

lines.zh: 我的手指掐进你的衣领
lines.en: My fingers close on your collar.
That blow carries more than fifty.
You're knocked to the wall.
One joint clacks loudly.
That one wasn't part of the show.

lines.zh: 我的喙停在你的喉咙前
lines.en: My beak stops short of your throat.
Move again and it's too late.
The diner's closing time.

lines.zh: 我站在展示位上，灯刚亮
lines.en: The lights come up; I'm on my mark.

lines.zh: 披萨店的舞台上，我举着蛋糕
lines.en: On the pizzeria stage, I hold my cupcake.
The daytime me is well behaved.
The letters on my bib are still fresh.

lines.zh: 天花板上的摄像头冲我转过来
lines.en: The ceiling camera swings to me.

lines.zh: 我等着一批一批的孩子
lines.en: I wait for the children, in waves.

lines.zh: 我的脚底和地砖磨出印子
lines.en: My soles have worn marks in the tile.
The diner's daytime is loud.

lines.zh: 我就站在这里，到这儿的都看得见
lines.en: I stand here where everyone can see.
Only at night do I loosen up.
The jukebox starts a song.
Hello, welcome in.

lines.zh: 布料烧起来，味道很难闻
lines.en: My cloth catches; the smell is awful.

lines.zh: 我摔下舞台，零件散了一地
lines.en: I fall off the stage and parts scatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，我动不了了
lines.en: Water fills my shell and I stop moving.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到桌子另一头
lines.en: The blast throws me across the tables.
An arrow sticks in my bib.
That light makes my circuits jump.
My power is low; even standing strains me.

lines.zh: 雷打进电路，我抽了一下
lines.en: Lightning hits my circuits and I jerk.
I fall, and the stage is gone.
